skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.description: Use to author or revise a focused skill package from a goal and design, coordinating discovery, synthesis, and evaluation through companion skills. Use skills-discovery for search alone.

skills.name: skill-design
skills.description: Use to resolve a skill's responsibility, interface, and design tradeoffs from a brief or merge plan before authoring. It does not discover sources or implement the package.

skills.name: skill-evaluator
skills.description: Use to evaluate a skill package against frozen behavioral cases and a baseline, returning evidence and a readiness verdict. It does not author fixes or publish the skill.

skills.name: skill-evidence-collection
skills.description: Use to collect, normalize, and preserve bounded evidence about one skill or skill collection for a later evaluation, lifecycle, or evolution decision. It does not judge or change the target.

skills.name: skill-evolution
skills.description: Use to update one existing skill from new evidence while preserving its responsibility, provenance, compatibility, and a reviewable change record.

skills.name: skill-icon-design
skills.description: Use to design or refresh a distinct, accessible SVG icon for one skill package from its responsibility and visual constraints. It does not redesign other package content.

skills.name: skill-installation
skills.description: Use to install one approved skill package at an immutable source revision into a selected agent environment and return an auditable installation receipt.

skills.name: skill-lifecycle-review
skills.description: Use to determine the lifecycle state and next justified transition for one skill from current evidence without editing or publishing the package.

skills.name: skill-migration
skills.description: Use to migrate one skill package between collections while preserving behavior, provenance, history, compatibility, and an auditable handoff.

skills.name: skill-naming
skills.description: Use to select or review a skill's canonical name, grouping related skills by domain and checking scope, cardinality, and known collisions. Return a naming decision without renaming files.

skills.name: skill-optimization
skills.description: Use to improve one skill through scored rollouts, bounded candidate edits, and held-out validation. It does not discover sources, author unrelated skills, or publish changes.

skills.name: skill-publication
skills.description: Use to publish one approved skill package through an authorized distribution channel after exact-revision release gates have passed.

skills.name: skill-routing
skills.description: Use to decide whether a task should activate one skill, an ordered set of skills, or no skill from supplied catalogs. It recommends a route but does not invoke, install, or modify skills.

skills.name: skill-security-review
skills.description: Use to review one skill package for secrets, private data, unsafe instructions, dangerous scripts, dependencies, permissions, and disclosure risk.

skills.name: skills-audit
skills.description: Use to audit a collection of installed or authored skills for inventory, provenance, validation, policy, and drift, producing one findings report.

skills.name: skills-catalog
skills.description: Use to create, synchronize, or validate a repository catalog of skill packages from their SKILL.md metadata. It maintains inventory and summaries but does not choose a skill for a task.

skills.name: skills-discovery
skills.description: Use to discover and qualify existing skills for a specific task, returning pinned candidates and evidence. It does not install, merge, or author a skill.

skills.name: skills-host-compatibility
skills.description: Use to verify declared repository-local aliases for a canonical skill collection and return a bounded structural compatibility report.

skills.name: skills-maintenance-scheduling
skills.description: Use to turn an approved recurring maintenance goal for a bounded skill collection into an approval-ready schedule proposal. It does not configure a scheduler or execute maintenance.

skills.name: skills-refactoring
skills.description: Use to turn an audit of an existing skill collection into a bounded decomposition and reorganization plan without editing the packages.

skills.name: skills-snapshot
skills.description: Create, verify, list, restore, and explicitly prune deterministic snapshots of a caller-selected skill collection or package. Use before risky skill maintenance; do not use to install or refactor skills.

skills.name: skills-synthesis
skills.description: Use to synthesize useful contributions from two or more reviewed skills into one coherent synthesis plan. It does not search for candidates, write the final package, or certify its quality.
